name: Globe Life Inc.
research_rationale: TTM cash flow still fits the strong-buy screen, but Q3 health-underwriting volatility, weaker post-earnings sentiment, and a trimmed Morgan Stanley target leave research only partly aligned.

weekly_updates.summary:
Morgan Stanley reaffirmed its rating on 23 Nov but cut the price target from $197 to $190.  
Coverage since the prior memo still centres on an ~8.8% fall after Q3 results and on Medicare or group-health margin pressure.  
No new company filings appeared in this batch; litigation and governance risks look unchanged.
